laterReadOnlyDiagnosis.classification: fixture identity mismatch; attribution added after the run; raw coordinator closure remains unchanged and historically marks attribution pending
laterReadOnlyDiagnosis.mechanism: The spec creates a 74-character requested Explorer name. The create service passes the name through StableExplorerID, which truncates IDs to 64 characters. The workflow ignores the create response and immediately GETs the Builder using the original 74-character name, so it addresses an Explorer ID that was never stored.

sourceReferences.fact: The case name is embedded in qa-reshape-${name}-${randomUUID()}.
Create calls StableExplorerID(request.Name) and returns the stored ExplorerID in its summary.
StableExplorerID normalizes the name and truncates IDs longer than 64 characters.
The workflow constructs endpoints from cda.explorer, posts create without retaining its response, then GETs the Builder using that requested identifier.

laterReadOnlyDiagnosis.suggestedCorrection: Use the canonical Explorer ID returned by create when setting the fixture target/workflow endpoint; alternatively generate a request name whose normalized form is at most 64 characters.
